heading: INT. NIGHT MARKET FISH STALL - 3 A.M.

units.text: INT. NIGHT MARKET FISH STALL - 3 A.M.
Crushed ice, tin tubs, and a hanging bulb swinging in the draft of the refrigeration fans.
Silver bodies glisten in rows.
A radio plays something thin and old.
INSPECTOR HONOR MBEKI, forties, in a gray trench, stands under the bulb with her hands in her pockets.
Across the counter, WEI-LING CHEN, sixties, a fishmonger in rubber boots, guts a snapper with a short, bright knife.
Between them, on the ice, a plastic bag with something heavy and dark inside.
Behind the stall, half-hidden by the tarp, KENDRICK "KEN" DOYLE, thirties, in a hoodie, watches and chews a thumbnail.
In the far corner, ZSOFIA SZABO, seventies, who sells the next stall's lemons, sits on an upturned crate peeling one with her thumbnail, apparently asleep.
Mrs. Chen. This bag was in your ice.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Everything's in my ice.
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: Is it yours?
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: I sell fish.
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: The knife keeps moving.
Ken shifts his weight.
The tarp rustles.
Mbeki's eyes flick to it, and back.
Anyone else want to claim it?
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Silence.
Zsofia's lemon peel falls in a single long spiral.
Not mine.
units.name: KEN

units.text: I didn't ask you, Mr. Doyle.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: You said anyone.
units.name: KEN

units.text: So I did.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Wei-Ling lays the knife down, wipes her hands, and slides the bag toward Mbeki across the ice without breaking eye contact.
Ken starts forward, stops.
Zsofia opens one eye.
Mbeki takes the bag, weighs it, and sets it down.
Mrs. Chen. Open it.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Why?
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: Because it's yours.
units.name: MBEKI

units.text: Wei-Ling's face doesn't move.
But her hand, reaching for the zipper, trembles.
She opens it.
Inside: a heavy iron key ring, dozens of keys, and a folded photograph of a young man.
She looks at the photo for a long time.
That is my son.
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: Ken drops his thumb from his teeth.
Zsofia, quietly, sets down the lemon.
